page.notes: The page is printed in Syriac (Serto script), not Latin, Greek or Hebrew. The scan is too small and the cursive Serto letters are too close together for me to read them letter by letter, so every line is marked illegible. The line count is approximate: about 21 full lines and one short final line at the bottom left. I did not guess at words, because a plausible but wrong Syriac reading would go unnoticed. A transcription needs a higher-resolution scan, ideally with a Syriac-literate reader checking it. The paragraph divisions are uncertain as well. Possible breaks appear near the colon-marked line about two-thirds down the page and before the final short line, but I could not confirm them, so the whole text sits in one paragraph.
